newsitem.title: USA: Humongous, Lancit plan licensing pact - Times.
newsitem.headline: Humongous, Lancit plan licensing pact - Times.

text.p: Humongous Entertainment planned to announce Wednesday it licensed the use of some of its computer games characters to Lancit Media Entertainment for television and video programming and motion pictures, the New York Times said Wednesday.

Terms of the deal were not disclosed, but the companies would share all net revenues from programming sales, the paper said. Humongous CD-ROM characters include Putt-Putt the purple car, Freddi Fish and Pajama Sam, it said.
Seattle-based Humongous is a unit of GT Interactive Software Corp.
